SELECT date_trunc($1, "shop_order"."created_at") AS day,
       sum("shop_order"."total_cents") AS revenue
FROM "shop_order"
WHERE "shop_order"."created_at" >= $2
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
SELECT "shop_product"."id", "shop_product"."sku", "shop_product"."name" FROM "shop_product" WHERE UPPER("shop_product"."name"::text) LIKE UPPER($1) ORDER BY "shop_product"."name" ASC LIMIT $2

SELECT "shop_order"."id", "shop_order"."customer_id", "shop_order"."external_ref", "shop_order"."status", "shop_order"."total_cents", "shop_order"."created_at" FROM "shop_order" WHERE "shop_order"."customer_id" = $1 ORDER BY "shop_order"."created_at" DESC LIMIT $2

SELECT "shop_order"."id", "shop_order"."customer_id", "shop_order"."external_ref", "shop_order"."status", "shop_order"."total_cents", "shop_order"."created_at" FROM "shop_order" WHERE "shop_order"."external_ref" = $1 ORDER BY "shop_order"."created_at" DESC LIMIT $2
